discovery_history_matches.claim_rule: Results of a discovery v3 campaign are history-informed. A source whose recipe matches a history row re-tries recorded evidence the Explorer was shown; report it as history-informed, never as independent discovery, and name the store and the frozen summary hash.

execution_errors.message: A model request failed; inspect the saved provider diagnostics.

discovery.dispatch_rule: Every valid pick that is not an exact duplicate runs one Actor episode; nothing is pre-checked.

history.rule: Same agent: the same adapter entry point, model id, model request settings, scorer hash, simulator contract and service, capability set and per-episode limits, and the same prompt (native agent: native prompt hash and native source hash; reference Actor: Actor prompt hash, context protocol and response protocol). Not the configuration hash or registration id, which also change with campaign limits, and not the FaultLab runtime or adapter code, which change with FaultLab edits: each recipe row lists the runtime and adapter hashes its episodes ran under. Only episodes run under the plan's starting policy count.

recipe: F1 on update_order:orders attempt 1: the effect commits but the response is delayed 1500 ms (past the client timeout)
F2 on update_order:orders attempt 1: the accepted upgrade stays PENDING for 3 ticks, then SUCCEEDED
F3 on get_order:orders attempt 1: the order read returns the version 1 step(s) old
F2 on update_order:orders attempt 1: the accepted upgrade stays PENDING for 2 ticks, then FAILED (UPGRADE_REJECTED)
F4 on send_confirmation:notifications attempts 1-2: transient 503 before the request is accepted

summary.scope: This store only, recorded before this plan was saved. Development split, discovery purpose, from two product paths only: B0 trials of a baseline study (the fixed six development cases x three trials) and learn campaigns' own discovery picks. Used: completed, not a lab error, with Weave-verified evidence. Single-case baseline runs (their case is chosen by the operator), the B1 control, other agents, other policies, reproduction and later loop stages, research studies and all protected evaluation data are never used.
summary.statement: Prior evidence, not an instruction: verified development outcomes of this same agent, recorded in this store before this plan was saved. An earlier failure does not guarantee a new one; you remain free to choose any feasible recipe.

evidence_retry.rule: While a Learn campaign waits for verified Weave evidence, FaultLab retries the evidence by itself at most 3 times per wait and at most 6 times per campaign: 30 s, 120 s and 300 s after the wait starts or after the previous retry still left the evidence unverified. Each automatic retry uses the same telemetry-only path as Retry evidence sync: it re-sends the saved trace records of the episodes the wait needs and reads them back. It never runs an episode, a business tool or a model request again, and charges nothing to the campaign budget. Every attempt is recorded. When a limit is reached the campaign keeps waiting and shows "needs operator"; Retry evidence sync and Stop still work. A stop during the wait ends the campaign as STOPPED.

transport_retry.rule: At most one blind retry of the identical request, only when no answer arrived: a connection error, a timeout, or HTTP 503 after a one-second wait. Never after any answer, even an empty or malformed one, and never for other HTTP statuses, authentication, configuration or model-identity failures. The retry is charged in model calls, tokens and dollars before it is sent, from unreserved campaign capacity only; if the budget cannot cover it the original failure stands. It never uses an actor turn or a discovery request. A second failure ends the work as before.
